turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm digging into some new papers. Have you heard of the Voyager project?
I'm familiar with the name. What specifically are you looking for?
Just checking the origins. It was introduced by Wang et al. (NVIDIA) in May 2023.
Understood. I'll note that provenance for you.
Cool. Also, did my package from Amazon arrive yet? I'm waiting on that HDMI cable.
It looks like it was delivered yesterday afternoon.
Great, thanks. I'll set it up later.
Lloyd, quick question about our evaluation framework.
I've been adjusting the scoring logic. Eval metrics are scored against a noise floor ceiling rather than 1.0.
That makes sense for robustness. I've updated the context.
Good. Oh, and can you remind me what we're having for dinner tonight?
You mentioned pasta earlier, but I don't have a confirmed reservation.
Right, we'll just cook at home. Thanks.
